facts.text: Andrew went hiking with friends on Last Friday, and the weather was great.

evidence.quote: Last Friday, I hiked with some friends. The weather was great and it felt so good to be outdoors.

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that he has been missing the connection with nature and the peace it brings.

evidence.quote: Lately, I've been really missing that connection with nature and the peace it brings.

facts.text: Andrew expressed interest in sharing photos from his hike with Audrey, but he hasn't gone through the photos yet.

evidence.quote: You want to share some awesome outdoor pics with me?
Haven't gone through the photos yet. Maybe soon!

facts.text: Andrew described the experience of being outdoors as lovely, with bird songs and the smell of trees.

evidence.quote: It was lovely being out in the open, hearing the bird songs and smelling the trees.
